notes: F1 (pre-existing, NOT introduced by this PR): test/chart renderChart() uses cmd.CombinedOutput(), so a helm stderr warning (e.g. group/world-readable KUBECONFIG) corrupts the parsed YAML stream and fails the whole chart package. Repro: scripts/repro-f1-chart-test-stderr-pollution.sh (deterministic; results/f1-repro.txt). Reproduced identically on base 73e05db4, so it is parked as non-blocking and deliberately excluded from this manifest's re-verify exit gate. Additional non-gating checks: scripts/check-manifest-drift.sh (kustomize regeneration parity, results/manifest-drift.txt) and scripts/check-release-artifacts.sh (published-image provenance, results/release-artifacts.txt).
